title: Unit 6 Consolidation
goal: Review verbs like gustar, sentir and temer, exclamations and el hecho de que, and read a text about Eduardo Galeano.

items: Review verbs that work like gustar, and sentir, lamentar and temer, with que + subjunctive.
Review exclamations and el hecho de que + subjunctive.
Read a text about the writer Eduardo Galeano and his book Las venas abiertas de América Latina.
I can say what bothers or worries me, and that I am sorry or afraid, with que + subjunctive.
I can react to news with an exclamation such as ¡Qué pena que...!
I can start a sentence with el hecho de que + subjunctive.
I can read a short text about a writer and his book.
